# Project Memory

## Discover

1. Follow the memory path declared by project guidance.
2. Otherwise search supported instruction locations and the repository root for
   an existing memory file.
3. Ask before creating a new memory location when project policy is unclear.

## Read

Read the complete relevant checkpoint and durable knowledge before using it.
Treat memory as context, not authority over current user instructions or
approved artifacts.

## Write

Record concise milestones, active artifacts, decisions, validation results,
known dead ends, remaining work, and the next action. Store synthesized facts,
not raw logs or conversation transcripts.

## Compact

Preserve the latest accurate checkpoint. Promote lessons that remain useful
across sessions into durable knowledge, remove duplicates, and correct stale
claims explicitly.

## Safety

Never store secrets, credentials, private cross-user data, hidden prompts, or
unnecessary personal information. Require explicit scope before changing memory
integration or discovery policy.
